payload.summary: Validated the non-deployable review-convergence guardrails through three authorized vendor-panel rounds. Required spec, package, test, traceability, and changed-surface lint gates passed; advisory modularity debt is issue #535.

decisions.title: Defer behavior-preserving module splits
decisions.rationale: Architecture size checks are advisory and a split would widen the incident-recovery change; GitHub issue #535 owns the follow-up.
